name: Janet Louise Harwood

public.text: I’m Janet Harwood, 76, and I’m retired after working in adult education and student services at Portland Community College. These days I volunteer with a library literacy program and a senior center. My top 10 interests are: 1) reading historical fiction and family sagas, 2) local Portland history, 3) volunteering with adult learners, 4) gardening herbs and tomatoes on my balcony, 5) walking in parks with a friend, 6) book club and community talks, 7) local civic issues and seniors’ advocacy, 8) cooking family recipes with my grandchildren, 9) crosswords and jigsaw puzzles, and 10) classical music and gentle British mysteries. As for bottled gazpacho, my rating is 5: I would certainly buy it. I already routinely buy single-serving bottled gazpacho and other chilled vegetable drinks for convenience. The brand, sodium content, and price affect which one I choose, but I like the idea very much.

justification: She says she would certainly buy it and already routinely buys single-serving bottled gazpacho and other chilled vegetable drinks.

name: Stephen Michael Donnelly

public.text:
I’m Stephen Donnelly, a senior research technician and independent consultant in community health research here in San Francisco. I’ve spent decades working hands-on in labs and helping community clinics with practical research and training.

My top 10 interests are:
1. Community health projects and neighborhood outreach
2. Cooking vegetarian meals from scratch
3. Reading science and public-health writing
4. Gardening on my balcony
5. Local lectures and small cultural outings
6. Puzzle and strategy games
7. Keeping up with health policy and community news
8. Folk and acoustic music
9. Short bike rides and neighborhood errands
10. Repairing household items and small instruments

Gazpacho purchase propensity: 1. I would never buy it. I strongly dislike cold blended vegetable soups, so a bottled version doesn’t appeal to me.

justification: He would never buy it because he strongly dislikes cold blended vegetable soups.
